Prince of Arathor | status = Deceased | relatives = [[Thoradin III]] (father) }} '''Lenarol I'''[[The Silverpine Wars]] was the king of the [[Empire of Arathor]] at the time of the Gilnean war of independence, having succeeded his father [[Thoradin III]] following his death in the battle of [[Stillward Church|Stillward]].[[The First Greymane]] Prince Lenarol was the one who came to sue for peace with the Gilneans, bestowing upon them the lands of the Gilnean peninsula into Silverpine Forest. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Succession|[[Thoradin III]]|'''[[Empire of Arathor|Ruler of Strom]]'''|Unknown, eventually came to be ruled by the [[Trollbane family]] (As [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|Stromgarde]])}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Aristocrats]] [[Category:Deceased characters]] [[Category:Arathor]]
